correctness.rationale: The scalar antiderivative gives a C1 gradient energy. Strong negative central (including kink-inward) curvature rules out any local-energy-minimum equilibrium there. All remaining equilibria are exactly invertible signed resolvent states with negative-definite Jacobian; positivity, symmetry and row sums give the sharp iff one-dissenter and all-sign criteria. Exact-rational verification succeeded for 117 finite cases. No unproved global-attraction inference.
